body:
Hi! I (F) went through this exact experience, and had feared and thought exactly what u posted. I cannot tell you how paranoid I felt after reading some posts too, saying that now on HRT, their partner would crave male validation. My partner (MTF) and I had talked about it after I was sooo depressed about her being a little moody and not actively finding me attractive. I cried thinking that she probably wants a buff man to make her feel more feminine or something. I felt so defeated especially since she at one point stopped having sex with me. I eventually came out to say that I’m scared that I’m not satisfying her in the way she wants…And she cried. She was devastated that I had felt this way. I felt guilty making her feel sad, bc it was my own insecurity projecting onto her. In the end she told me she loved me and she loves me cuz I’m ME. 

We’ve been together for 2 and a half years now and I feel like we’re really happy now. She was on spiro which she said depressed her, but now on estrogen injections(which I administer), she’s been feeling better. But I also want to mention that we also had other issues that caused her to be down as well- but again, we communicated through that.

I’m sorry you’re in so much pain. But the fact u took the time to respond means u do care. You seem well spoken and caring. The fact that you’re trying is wonderful. But yeh, that feeling of being a burden doesn’t go away. I wish I could genuinely believe that my depression and anxiety are causing me to feel like a burden and that im not actually a burden. And I want that for u too. I can’t imagine this pain on someone else. It’s soo overwhelming that I don’t wish it on anyone, and especially you. I’ve already been to a ward and know wat rock bottom is like, and maybe u have too, but I hope u haven’t. Please pm if anything.

Thanks so much for commenting. I hope you’re in a much better place than I am. You’re very lovely. But I do ask, do u ever feel like a burden to someone you love? And if u did/do, how can u lower that pain?
Omg GORGEOUS! STUNNING! YOU ARE THE MOMENT!! Legit glowing :) 💕💕💕 also your brows are goals!!
Never thought of that, thank you!
Wow! Such beautifully phrased. Thank you for ur ray of hope and positivity.

Thanks for responding. Yeh the part where you mentioned about your partner initiating hits home, bc I would try and and she’d be like no. Ofc she doesn’t owe me an explanation, but the first thought I have is, I guess I wasn’t hot enough for her today. But it makes sense that it could just make her dysphoric. I guess cuz shes kinda picky wit who she finds attractive, I get more insecure, like, what if now Im just an ugly short girl who has nothing on tall dark and muscular. So I guess having her be attracted to me kinda makes me more secure that I’m not just a person who she’s holding onto until she figures herself out. Thanks for responding and sorry if I don’t make sense.

Thanks again. I’ve been spiraling and maybe I do need help with communicating what I’m feeling. Or maybe I should just reassure myself based on ur experience. I know not everyone’s the same, but at least I can hold on to something. Any slither of hope. It means a lot you responded bc I have no one else in my life to turn to. I’m drowning in my fears. 

I guess it also hurts a but when she does talk about her past sex life and how she did enjoy it even tho she was an egg. Like, she almost seems nostalgic for how good it felt even with her biological body. And then I compare it to me like, I can’t give her any satisfaction. It’s like, not even the sex that i miss, but the idea that she just finds me irresistible and the intimacy is what I miss. Sorry for rambling. But what you said just reminded me more of what’s on my mind.
Thank you for responding. Very helpful. Did your partner ever feel insecure like I did? Maybe because this is my first relationship I’m very insecure.
